Hon'ble Subhash Vidyarthi,J.
1.

Heard Mr. Vinod Kumar Singh, learned counsel for the applicant, Sri Arpit Kumar, learned A.G.A.
for the State and perused the records.

2. The instant application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No.1151 of 2023, Under Section- 419, 420, 467, 468, 471, 120B IPC and 6/10 U.P. Public Examination Act, Police Station- Kotwali Nagar, District Barabanki.

3. The aforesaid case has been registered on the basis of an FIR lodged on 28.10.2023 stating that the applicant was appearing in place of another candidate in the PET examination being held on 28.10.2023.

4. In the affidavit filed in support of bail application it has been stated that the applicant is innocent,
he has been falsely implicated in the present case and he has no previous criminal history.

sentences.text: 5. The learned A.G.A. has opposed the prayer for bail but he could not dispute the aforesaid aspects of the matter.

6. Having considered the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case and keeping in view the fact that that the applicant has no previous criminal history and is languishing in jail since 28.10.2023 without making any observation, which may affect the merits of the case, I am of the view that the applicant is entitled to be released on bail in the aforesaid crime.
7. Accordingly, this bail application stands allowed.
